column3: (Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: the app source has plain-English code comments on purpose)
(Timestamp Disclosure: exam dates and version numbers in the page, not server timestamps)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: public static site, caching is intended)

(CSP: style-src allows unsafe-inline, accepted, scripts are hash-locked. frame-ancestors 'self' is now sent as a Cloudflare response header (added Nov 19 2026), so the no-fallback alert should clear; keep WARN to watch unsafe-inline)

(Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin is sent as a Cloudflare response header since Nov 19 2026. The rest of 90004 is COEP, not needed: the site loads nothing cross-origin and doesn't use cross-origin isolation)
(Application Error Disclosure: false positive, the text is a log sample in a SQL-injection practice question; a static site has no server errors to leak. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Debug Error Messages: same practice-question log sample as 90022. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Private IP Disclosure: example lab networks like 10.10.5.20 in questions and diagrams, not real hosts. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Base64 Disclosure: the CSP's sha256 script hashes and inline data, public by design. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: GitHub Pages sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin *; every file is public and no cookies or logins exist. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Re-examine Cache-control: GitHub Pages' default 10-minute cache on public files is intended. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Retrieved from Cache: Cloudflare's cache serving public files, intended. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
(Sec-Fetch-* headers missing: these are browser request headers a server may check; a static site has nothing to protect with them. Reviewed Nov 19 2026)
